events.name: Vegas Golden Knights at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Brayden Schenn scored the game-winning goal at 18:27 of the third period, leading the St. Louis Blues to a 4-3 victory over the Vegas Golden Knights on Friday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Schenn scores game-winning goal as Blues beat Golden Knights 4-3

events.name: New York Rangers at Florida Panthers

headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers beat Panthers 5-1 in first outdoor hockey game in Miami. Mika Zibanejad has hat trick

headlines.description: — Matty Beniers scored the only goal int he shootout to give the Seattle Kraken a 4-3 win against the Vancouver Canucks on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Matty Beniers scores in shootout to give Kraken 4-3 win over Canucks

headlines.description: — Danila Yurov scored twice, Quinn Hughes had four assists and the Minnesota Wild beat the Anaheim Ducks 5-2 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Danila Yurov scores 2 goals, Quinn Hughes has 4 assists as surging Wild beat Ducks 5-2
